title: Pure Evil Eye
summary: Evil Eye cards only, with generic Fiend Links and staples. Evil Eye of Selene is the core: equipped to an Evil Eye monster, it makes it immune to their targeting and destruction and switches on its strongest effect. Serziel then destroys a Special Summoned monster, and Medusa banishes from their GY. Every Evil Eye Spell/Trap also gets stronger while Selene is on the field. Selene costs 500 LP each time you activate an Evil Eye card, and Evil Eye of Gorgoneio counts as Selene and turns that LP gap into ATK. The 2023 cards lead. Evil Eyes Unleashed mills an Evil Eye monster and Spell/Trap to search an Equip Spell. Basiltrice summons itself on either turn and Link Summons on the opponent's turn. Zerrziel and Gorgon destroy or negate once equipped. Evil Eye Reemergence limits you to Fiends.
